decisions.name: Evidence availability and observation map
decisions.reason: Literal availability, observed-result and sensitivity columns preserve unavailable inputs, inspected absence and unmeasured quantities without a strength heatmap.
decisions.evidence: A06/C01 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F01.

decisions.name: Hypothesis episodes
decisions.reason: Hypothesis lanes distinguish events and open/excluded endpoints; arcs show corrections and bound resolution. This adaptation replaces the original duration guidance: positions encode reading order, not duration or confidence.
decisions.evidence: A06/C02 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F02.

decisions.name: Claim, warrant and rebuttal
decisions.reason: Toulmin diagrams connect observations through warrants to bounded claims, with separate custody and rebuttal links. R05 and R18 retain their different evidence and limits.
decisions.evidence: A06/C03 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F03.

decisions.name: Aligned observation tracks
decisions.reason: All 512 exact position rows are drawn as separate window/context annotation tracks. Counts are derived from the public source; recurrence does not represent key membership.
decisions.evidence: A06/C04 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F04.

decisions.name: Source-to-claim translation
decisions.reason: Three explicitly distinct source routes align a field, reading and ceiling. This is interpretation, not literal translation or pooled evidence.
decisions.evidence: A06/C05 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F10.

decisions.name: Artifact exchange diagram
decisions.reason: Artifact nodes and event vertices carry labeled exchanges. One pair feeds keyed, analytical and keyless operations; dates identify receipts. Interaction geometry implies no physical amplitudes or measured time scale.
decisions.evidence: A06/C06 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F05.

decisions.name: Shared-input map
decisions.reason: Named shared IDs/profile connections expose input reuse. Observer code and expected output are supplied separately; categorical bonds imply neither measured covariance nor independent samples.
decisions.evidence: A06/C07 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F05.

decisions.name: Provenance cutaway
decisions.reason: Separated conceptual planes, alignment guides and source-linked callouts distinguish bytes, export, profile, verification and claim. Depth and spacing encode no confidence or universal causal pipeline.
decisions.evidence: A06/C08 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F06.

decisions.name: Measured comparisons with conditions
decisions.reason: Three paired nominal-z rows include exact primary hit counts and denominators. The full 18-row searchable table belongs beside this figure in the report; no invented intervals. Historical seven-row costs remain narrative/table content because they need separate units and lineage limits.
decisions.evidence: A06/C09 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F07.

decisions.name: Claim-condition crosswalk
decisions.reason: Selected ledger claims are shown with their explicit evidence and missing conditions. L-10/L-12/L-13 remain visibly excluded. No claim-to-question/gate edges are invented; full identities are separate report registers.
decisions.evidence: A06/C10 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F08.

decisions.name: Static detail and research index
decisions.reason: Use the full visible 42-record appendix, stable IDs, indexes and page references in the report. A separate figure would duplicate the navigation and could hide essential limits.
decisions.evidence: A06/C11 records this selection and its limit. Document treatment or deliberate omission is explicit; no unmeasured quantitative figure is claimed.

decisions.name: Correction and dependency links
decisions.reason: Sparse labeled arcs show documented corrections and bound resolution in F02. F10 retains source-interpretation routes. Connections do not measure authority or independent evidence.
decisions.evidence: A06/C12 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F02, fig-F10.

decisions.name: Overlapping research themes
decisions.reason: No explicit multi-label taxonomy and reviewed membership matrix support an UpSet count. Record relationships are not assumed to be set membership.
decisions.evidence: A06/C13 records this selection and its limit. Document treatment or deliberate omission is explicit; no unmeasured quantitative figure is claimed.

decisions.name: Experiment lifecycle and stop states
decisions.reason: A continuation-state map retains closure, unavailable evidence, known unknowns, overlooked existing knowledge and discovery probes. It is conceptual, not a formal state machine or mandatory queue.
decisions.evidence: A06/C14 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F09.

decisions.name: Future experiment selection
decisions.reason: Optional continuation rules are retained categorically. Comparable measured cost, utility and information-gain inputs do not exist; no quantitative priority ranking is drawn.
decisions.evidence: A06/C15 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F09.

decisions.name: Research trajectory concept
decisions.reason: Categorical history supplies the supported substitute. No sampled numeric state trajectory, confidence coordinates or attractor is available.
decisions.evidence: A06/C16 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F02.

decisions.name: Multidimensional profile
decisions.reason: Custody, observation and novelty are not commensurate numeric axes; no radar, RadViz or parallel-coordinate synthesis is justified.
decisions.evidence: A06/C17 records this selection and its limit. Document treatment or deliberate omission is explicit; no unmeasured quantitative figure is claimed.

decisions.name: Monitoring and calibrated behavior
decisions.reason: No continuous telemetry, control baseline or qualified calibration population is available. No live badge, noise envelope, gauge or confidence percentage is drawn.
decisions.evidence: A06/C18 records this selection and its limit. Document treatment or deliberate omission is explicit; no unmeasured quantitative figure is claimed.

decisions.name: Branching and exchange
decisions.reason: Named exchanges and shared-input bonds supply a categorical schematic. No conserved count supports weighted ribbons or a 100-percent partition.
decisions.evidence: A06/C19 records this selection and its limit. Actual figures: fig-F05.

decisions.name: Design before pagination
decisions.reason: The original three-direction comparison remains amended. This revision compares four earlier plates with their analytical-card redesigns on unchanged evidence, then reviews the integrated pages. It is not completion of the original three-direction exercise.
decisions.evidence: A06/C20 records this selection and its limit. Document treatment or deliberate omission is explicit; no unmeasured quantitative figure is claimed.
